exposure: Registered scope, historical obligations and first SOURCE/PRIORS schema inspected; whole N/E surface not yet opened in this author turn.

constructors.effect: Explicitly introduce or refer to u/v/O/S/M. Generic wind variables range over actual wind participants, not names or kinds.
Bind a horizon frame to the written observer; no cardinal directions.
Relate source bearings, not destination bearings. Spatial opposition is not qualitative opposition.
State relative force on same written basis. No actual storm or numeric measurement is donated.
Explicitly order encounter and outcome; no clock interval.
Conjoin antecedents for same participant pair and frame; incomplete input is BLOCKED.

For opposed participants: unequal force leaves original stronger u/v blowing at t1, original weaker ceases because of that stronger; equal force mutually obstructs. Identity references input variables rather than fresh same-kind winds. Conditional consequence, not actual occurrence.

constructors.signature: ceased WindVariable,TimeOrder,ADJACENT relation,explicit solar/material cause -> WorldOutcome
constructors.effect: Optional mixed mechanism produces a distinct new participant after cessation; no generation from suppression alone and no cardinal donation. All causal inputs must be written.

Create nonnull generic world assertion: for every actual participant assignment satisfying this antecedent, its stated consequence holds. It changes an unasserted condition/outcome into a claim about winds. Shared operation required in exact bare aiin and d+aN forms, with consumers.
State an actual conditional property about the written participant/result. A survivor predicate consumes its original participant reference, not just a kind name.
Conjoin claims without erasing participant/frame/time distinctions.

Instantiate/refer to the rule for written participant/condition, retaining the actual outcome identity. No OriginalOnly type restriction; a fair fresh participant can be supplied but changes the proposition.

core_vocabulary.aiin: Bare exact root executing shared aN on written condition and outcome; not a fabricated child of d/q/ok.
core_vocabulary.daiin: Exact d+aN: same aN assertion plus separately paid d participant-directed application.
core_vocabulary.shodaiin: Fixed So·daN: same dai(in) interface plus paid So spatial/source contribution if actual frame arguments are available; not one learned whole.
core_vocabulary.or: World assertion/application marker taking a UniversalWorldRule or WorldProposition, not the historical IDEA582 Assertable rule. Exact new candidate entry costs required.
core_vocabulary.shedy: Potential participant/property predication, not a silent cast from the predecessor region description.

references: Most recent explicitly bound wind pair, observer/frame, strength comparison, time ordering, condition and outcome within continuous written scope. Exact paid lexical bindings establish them; native line/block metadata alone does not reset identity. Cross-block carry and every UNKNOWN bridge are costs and unresolved assumptions, never inferred word meanings.
scope_policy: A generic rule may be reintroduced by explicit written lexical setup; no per-locus passage lookup, invisible record reset or new physical identity. Variables u/v retained until a paid explicit role rebinding.
dictionary: Additional exact whole templates can compose only these families and reuse constants, with explicit entry/alias/reference/compound/ambient premise cost. No unseen cardinal names, forced rarity-as-name, universal productive prefix, null parts or undecoded alternative substitution. Missing inputs and unused instructions stay visible.
historical_limits: Suppression and succession may coexist but only with explicit different transitions. Source conditional does not prove antecedent occurred. Static indexed-time account can match these commitments. No clearing-sky or equal-strength survivor inference.
blinding: No B/C constructors or content read.
